applicableAreas: Southern boundary of site, running parallel to overhead electric line
findings.comment: Trees are shown planted along the southern site boundary within approximately 5-10 feet of the overhead electric line (based on graphic scale 1"=20'). However, the landscape plan does not identify the species of these trees, so utility-compatible status per ECM Appendix F cannot be verified. Plant species schedule exists on Sheet 35 but is not cross-referenced to specific locations on the landscape plan. Provide species identification labels on the landscape plan for all trees proposed within 25 feet of overhead electric facilities.

applicableAreas: Southern boundary of site, running parallel to overhead electric line; western street yard area near Valley View Road
findings.comment: Large trees (mature height 40+ feet) cannot be verified as meeting the 25-foot clearance requirement from distribution conductors because the landscape plan does not identify which species are planted at which locations. While Live Oak and Cedar Elm are shown in the plant schedule with 16-foot minimum heights, their mature heights per ECM Appendix F cannot be verified against specific planting locations on the site plan. Provide species identification and mature height notation on landscape plan for all proposed trees.

applicableAreas: Entire site, all proposed trees near overhead electric facilities
findings.comment: The landscape plan does not identify species of trees proposed near overhead electric facilities. Trees are shown with category symbols (M=Mitigation, SY=Street Yard, PL=Parking Lot) and geometric symbols but no botanical or common names are labeled on the plan. While a complete plant schedule exists on Sheet 35 listing Cedar Elm, Live Oak, Mexican Redbud, and Texas Mountain Laurel with quantities, this schedule is not cross-referenced to specific tree locations on the landscape plan. Add species common names or abbreviations (e.g., 'CE' for Cedar Elm, 'LO' for Live Oak) to tree symbols on the landscape plan for all trees within 50 feet of overhead electric facilities.

applicableAreas: Entire site, particularly southern boundary and western boundary where trees and overhead electric lines overlap
findings.comment: The overhead electric line is shown on the landscape plan, but trees are not clearly related to it with dimensions. While both overhead electric lines and tree symbols are visible on Sheet 31, there are no dimension lines, call-outs, or notes indicating clearance distances between the trees and conductors. Sheet 21 shows electrical infrastructure separately from the landscape. Cross-reference the two plans with dimension lines or notes showing clearance distances between trees and overhead conductors, demonstrating compliance with 15-foot (distribution) and 50-foot (transmission) requirements.
